title: Keynote-style product launch (parody) — a hero product on white, features, a size counter, a macro close-up, a battery gag, a card, the price

source.author: @raphaelaubryy
source.note: Remade from scratch in HyperFrames after the 'Baguette Pro' keynote parody; structure and pacing follow it. The three photos were generated with the Claude Imagine MCP (nano-banana-2, 2k); none of the original's images are used.

scenes: 'Introducing' — the product is revealed by a soft wipe from left to right on a white stage
the name rises in, holds, and leaves upwards; the product keeps growing slowly
a feature line in black and gold under the product, a little steam
a size counter rolls up while a gold ruler draws under the product, with a footnote
the camera pushes into the product and cuts to a full-screen macro close-up with two lines
the close-up folds into a battery icon that drains and refills, with a footnote
the battery is pushed out by a card with a second photo and a two-line joke
'Designed in … Baked every morning.' then the product returns for the name, price and availability

images.use: hero product on white (background lifted to pure white, cropped to the product and its shadow)
images.prompt: Studio product photograph of one thick, plump, rustic artisan French baguette lying perfectly horizontal, seen exactly from the side, centered, spanning about 85% of the frame width. Deeply caramelized dark golden-brown crust, dramatic diagonal scoring with raised crispy ears, blistered and crackled surface, darker tips. Isolated on a pure white seamless background with a soft natural contact shadow underneath. Crisp, high detail, premium tech-launch product shot. Nothing else in the frame, no text.

images.use: full-screen macro close-up, then the battery fill
images.prompt: Extreme macro close-up of a freshly torn French baguette filling the whole frame: on the left a thick, deeply caramelized golden-brown crust dusted with flour, crackled and blistered; on the right the airy open crumb with glossy irregular holes. Warm low side light, shallow depth of field, rich texture, editorial food photography. No text.

Three thick chunks of rustic baguette stacked loosely on top of each other in a small tower, each showing golden crust on the outside and soft open crumb where it was cut, slightly off-balance. Dramatic soft studio light from the upper left on a pure black background, centered, vertical composition, premium food photography. No text.

notes: To launch a different product, generate three images with the same prompts (swap the subject), keep the file names, and update IMG in the script: the pixel span of the product inside baguette.jpg (bx0, bx1) and its vertical centre (cy), so it is placed by its real width. The hero image is drawn with mix-blend-mode: multiply, so its background must be pure white. Keep the parody clearly a parody: no real company's logo, product names or claims.
